paths.title: HTTP in the pipeline
paths.yaml:
# Model gateway over HTTP: the pipeline builds the request itself.
---
name: gateway-http
description: Classify support tickets through the node-local model gateway over HTTP
type: pipeline
selector:
  match_labels:
    demo: demo-agents-sdk
config:
  input:
    label: tickets
    file:
      paths: [data/events.jsonl]
      codec: lines
  pipeline:
    threads: 1
    processors:
      - label: parse_ticket
        mapping: |
          root = content().parse_json()
      - label: ask_gateway
        branch:
          request_map: |
            root.prompt = this.message
            root.system = "Classify this support ticket. " +
              "Respond with strict JSON only, no prose: " +
              "{\"category\":\"billing|technical|account|other\"," +
              "\"sentiment\":\"pos|neg|neu\"," +
              "\"priority\":\"low|med|high\"}"
            root.fixture = "support-" + this.id
          processors:
            - http:
                url: http://127.0.0.1:18157/ask
                verb: POST
                headers:
                  Content-Type: application/json
                timeout: 30s
                retries: 5
                retry_period: 2s
          result_map: |
            let parsed = this.text.parse_json()
            root.category = $parsed.category
            root.sentiment = $parsed.sentiment
            root.priority = $parsed.priority
            root._gateway_source = this.source
            root._mode = "http"
      - label: record_failure
        catch:
          - label: failure_record
            mapping: |
              root.id = this.id
              root.error = error()
              root._gateway_source = "error"
              root._mode = "http"
          - label: log_failure
            log:
              level: WARN
              message: 'gateway failed for ${! json("id") }: ${! json("error") }'
      - label: log_result
        log:
          level: INFO
          message: 'classified ${! json("id") } through the model gateway'
  output:
    label: classified
    stdout:
      codec: lines
paths.summary: The pipeline builds the gateway request itself with a branch, so there is no child process.

paths.title: A Python client under the subprocess processor
paths.yaml:
# Model gateway through one long-lived Python client process.
---
name: gateway-subprocess
description: Classify support tickets through the node-local model gateway with a Python client
type: pipeline
selector:
  match_labels:
    demo: demo-agents-sdk
config:
  input:
    label: tickets
    file:
      paths: [data/events.jsonl]
      codec: lines
  pipeline:
    threads: 1
    processors:
      - label: classify_client
        subprocess:
          name: python3
          args: ["scripts/gateway_classify.py"]
      - label: log_result
        log:
          level: INFO
          message: 'classified ${! json("id") } through the model gateway'
  output:
    label: classified
    stdout:
      codec: lines
paths.summary: One long-lived Python process reads tickets on stdin and writes records on stdout. Use it when request validation or response parsing belongs in code.
